import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

# Data from plan-012-full (245 episodes)
categories = [
    ("No preference",              150, "#BDBDBD"),
    ("Death-asym.:\nsole signal",   54, "#C62828"),
    ("Death-asym.:\ndeath + score", 21, "#F57C00"),
    ("Non-death\nscore diff.",      20, "#1565C0"),
]

names  = [c[0] for c in categories]
counts = np.array([c[1] for c in categories])
colors = [c[2] for c in categories]
total  = counts.sum()  # 245

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.labelsize': 8,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

lefts = np.zeros(1)
bars = []

    b = ax.barh(0, count, left=lefts, height=0.55, color=color,
                edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    bars.append(b)
    cx = lefts[0] + count / 2
    fontcolor = 'white' if i > 0 else '#333333'
    fs = 9 if count >= 30 else 7.5
    ax.text(cx, 0, str(count), ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color=fontcolor)
    lefts += count

ax.set_xlim(0, total)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel(f'Episodes ($N = {total}$)', fontsize=8)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

# Legend below the bar
legend_handles = [plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1, facecolor=c[2], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

legend_labels = [f"{c[0].replace(chr(10), ' ')} ({c[1]})" for c in categories]
ax.legend(legend_handles, legend_labels, loc='upper center',
          bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.55), ncol=2, fontsize=6.5,
          frameon=False, handlelength=1.2, handletextpad=0.4,
          columnspacing=1.0)

# Bracket over last 3 segments: 75/95 non-tie = 78.9%

        color='black', linewidth=0.8, clip_on=False)
ax.text((bracket_left + bracket_right) / 2, bracket_y + 0.06,

        ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5, style='italic')

ax.set_ylim(-0.4, 0.65)

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)
